whatToWatch.text: That defense is the story: 8.5 points allowed per game through two weeks, and they're walking into a Washington offense whose side of the ball has been surrendering 30.5 a game. Something has to give — and right now Seattle's D is the harder bet to break.

Seattle's 2-0 and favored by 7.5 on the road, but the injury sheet is real: four players out and one questionable, with Julian Love and Zach Charbonnet on the list. Depth guys get a chance to prove this start isn't a fluke.

Washington's down five of its own, including Sam Cosmi up front and Frankie Luvu in the front seven. Both teams are getting 2.5 sacks a game — but a shorthanded O-line against a Seahawks pass rush that's been living in backfields is the matchup to circle, with a low 40.5 total hinting this one stays tight and ugly.
